**Limitations**

- Finds bright lines. Dark lines give negative responses, which the clip mapping hides.
- Only four directions and one-pixel width. Other line mask families, such as Laplacian-based or oriented line filters, are not included in this entry.

**Artifacts**

- Responses on edges as well as lines, weaker but not zero.
